response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced generalist engineer (15+ years, staff-level titles, strong TypeScript/Node, AWS CDK, Kubernetes, distributed low-latency systems, and a track record of teaching, mentoring and consulting). However, the role requires 8+ years building production AI solutions, and the resume shows roughly one year of AI-adjacent work (MCP code generators and agentic tooling at re:cinq). There is no evidence of Python, RAG architectures, vector databases, multi-agent frameworks, LLM evaluation/observability, or data pipelines for unstructured data — the core technical bar for this position. He could be a strong fit for a platform/infrastructure engineering role supporting GenAI, and MCP experience is directly relevant, but as a Staff Forward Deployed GenAI Engineer he is a stretch. Worth a screening call to probe the depth of the re:cinq AI-agent work.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production systems; deep TypeScript/Node, cloud (AWS CDK, Kubernetes, Docker) and testing/CI discipline
Hands-on MCP server/code-generator and agentic workflow tooling experience — directly matches a listed key technology
Proven mentoring, workshop delivery, consulting and open-source leadership (founder of GISCollective, conference talks, courses)
concerns: No demonstrated RAG, vector database, LLM evaluation/optimization, or multi-agent framework experience
Python absent from skills list despite being the primary language for the role
AI-specific experience appears to be ~1 year, far short of the required 8+ years of production AI delivery

key_factors.factor: Lack of core GenAI experience (RAG, vector DBs, evals)
Strong senior/staff engineering breadth, cloud and mentoring track record
Hands-on MCP and agentic tooling work
